description: Every copy the user owns of one deck row's card (want_id, from deck_status), wherever it is: each stack's printing, finish, condition, language, proxy flag, where it physically is (a deck's box when sleeved), its free copies, what this deck claims of it, and every other deck's claim (allocation_id, shared or not, sleeved or not). `fits` is false for a printing the row does not pin; `tournament_proxy` marks a proxy a tournament deck never claims. Always disclose: a copy another deck claims is that deck's, and taking it (take_claim) leaves that deck missing it; sharing it (claim_copy with shared:true) means both decks claim it. A free copy is claimed with claim_copy.
name: row_copies

claims.description: Every other deck's claim on the stack: disclose them

deck.description: The deck that claims the copies: name it whenever the copy is offered

shared.description: True: the deck borrows the copy and is not its owning deck

sleeved.description: True: the copy is physically in that deck's box

fits.description: False: the row pins another printing, so this copy does not cover it

in_deck_box.description: The place is a deck's box: the copy is sleeved in that deck

is_proxy.description: A proxy, not a real card: always say so

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

tournament_proxy.description: A proxy on a tournament deck: never claimed or taken there

pinned_scryfall_id.description: The printing the row pins; null: any printing

title: Row copies
